propositions: The --reason flag is advertised in transition help but the close_reason parameter is parsed and threaded through call layers then silently discarded on plain closes
close_reason parameter appears in transition_core signature at txn.py:197 but is never read in any function body
On non-force paths, --reason has no effect; it is only meaningful under --force paths as force_reason conditional at transition.py:293-294
The ticket scope explicitly rejects persisting close reasons via comments, having deliberately replaced free-text --reason with bounded CLOSE_CLASSES vocabulary per ed13 decision
Users passing --reason on plain closes reasonably believe the rationale was recorded but it silently drops the value
Documentation and error handling must clarify that --reason applies only to force paths, or the flag must be rejected on plain closes
